# official-runtime-readiness-checker (reference summary)

## Purpose
Evaluate whether official runtime appears ready using evidence-bound checks and explicit readiness states.

Run the evidence-bound readiness matrix to evaluate check completeness (`Ready | Partially Ready | Blocked | Unknown`) before any runtime attempt.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/official-runtime-readiness-checker/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/official-runtime-readiness-checker/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `runtime-and-execution` / `runtime-connection-and-version-preflight`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- to run the readiness matrix after prerequisites are framed (`official-runtime-setup-guide`) and a target path is selected (`runtime-path-picker`)
- before any runtime manual evaluation or planning handoff

## Trigger cues
- "check runtime readiness"
- "is runtime available"
- "can we run this now"
- "run the readiness matrix for our chosen Blender path"

## When not to use
- as proof that Blender ran or that runtime execution succeeded → delegate to `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skills/runtime-path-picker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to runtime-path-picker)
- as a substitute for runtime truth states (Not Run | Attempted | Produced | Verified | Failed) or artifact status (default Not Produced) → delegate to `path-one-host-outline` (`references/skills/path-one-host-outline.md`; default Not Produced)
- to choose a runtime path → delegate to `path-one-host-outline` (`references/skills/path-one-host-outline.md`; use path-one-host-outline)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `selected_runtime_path` (`string`): Target runtime path to verify (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+, Path 2 mcp-for-blender 3.0+, or CLI appendix)
- `observed_environment_signals` (`object`): Observed Blender version, enabled add-on state, MCP host configuration, and tool surface signals

### Optional inputs
- `port_or_session_diagnostics` (`object`): Optional port 9876 listener status or active Blender session count

### Primary outputs
- `runtime_readiness_matrix`
- `readiness_verdict_and_missing_prerequisites`
- `preserved_not_run_truth_state_block`

## Quick-start procedure
1. confirm this skill fits your goal
2. provide required inputs first
3. keep runtime claims evidence-bound
4. follow suggested next-skill handoff

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** If runtime path is not yet chosen → `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skills/runtime-path-picker.md`)
- **[upstream_reference]** If Path 1 host (a) or (b) outline is needed → `path-one-host-outline` (`references/skills/path-one-host-outline.md`)
- **[fallback]** If prerequisites/boundaries are missing (Blocked / Unknown) → `official-runtime-setup-guide` (`references/skills/official-runtime-setup-guide.md`)
- **[fallback]** If bridge contention is detected → `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skills/runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`)
- **[upstream_reference]** If CLI appendix job structure is needed → `cli-appendix-job-outline` (`references/skills/cli-appendix-job-outline.md`)
- **[alternative]** If Ready / Partially Ready and moving to scene planning (product-hero-scene-planner) → `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`)
- **[conditional]** If Ready / Partially Ready and moving to scene planning (workflow-stage-router) → `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skills/workflow-stage-router.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** - Readiness ≠ execution: `Ready` means readiness checks passed, never that Blender executed or artifacts exist. - Readiness statuses (`Ready | Partially Ready | Blocked | Unknown`) describe check completeness only; never conflate them with runtime truth states (`Not Run | Attempted | Produced | Verified | Failed`, downgrade-only) or artifact state (default `Not Produced`). - This skill can check local readiness signals. - This skill must not claim runtime artifact production. - This skill must not claim execution success without execution evidence. - Path 1 Anthropic Connector is never standalone: it always requires the Official Blender Lab MCP add-on installed inside Blender 5.1+. - Path 2 (`mcp-for-blender`) is third-party only, carries mandatory caveats, and is never release evidence. - CLI fallback (`blender --background --python`) is appendix-only and never a peer path without an evaluation record.
- runtime execution
- artifact generation claims
- uncaveated Path 2 / peer-path CLI fallback
